author: KorvinusRedSoap
quote: Good grief—I can’t find simple words to express this, but I spent 13 years waiting for this game. I was looking for an escape from reality, filled with uninhibited, acerbic humor—and, above all, freedom. Setting aside the miserable 30 fps, the story is a disaster: the protagonist is a total clown—a spineless, pathetic guy shackled to a trashy wife, with no chance of ever doing anything better. There’s no freedom for him, and no real drama. They claim they wanted to emulate *Red Dead*—a massive mistake. If I wanted a deep, introspective story, I’d play *Red Dead*. What I was looking for here was a power fantasy—which is now impossible, thanks to the pathetic protagonist, the limited gameplay features, and an absurd story.
